post_condition: Returns a dictionary whose top-level keys are the union of the top-level keys of base and overlay. For any key whose value is a dict in both base and overlay, the returned value is the recursive deep merge of those nested dicts. For any key whose value is not a dict in both base and overlay, or present in only one of the two inputs, the returned value is the overlay value when the key exists in overlay, otherwise the base value. Neither base nor overlay is mutated by the call.
